Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells and gasoline are each used to power cars.
Which statement describes an advantage of using hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells in cars in comparison
with gasoline engines?
A
Hydrogen is a non-renewable resource.
B
Hydrogen is produced during the fractional distillation of petroleum.
C
Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells do not release carbon dioxide.
D
Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells need electricity to work.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrogen is produced during the fractional distillation of petroleum.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells do not release carbon dioxide.

options.label: D
options.text: Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells need electricity to work.
